body: Important context: .aida/review-verdicts/PR-2217.json and STORY-1476.json already contain an exact-SHA REQUEST_CHANGES verdict at add0cf724397bdd2d68e3f359df0c0e058d23e72 (recorded by aida review record); preserve it. Independently verify both findings in the detached review worktree, then report whether you agree, with evidence. Finding 1: aida-cli-lib/src/lib.rs:63486-63490 trims allowlist entries before rejecting control chars, so trailing CR on "*" becomes wildcard trust; validate raw entries and test CR/LF/control whitespace. Finding 2: graded_review.rs:532-552 returns on a permitted-command failure before not_run_count is surfaced to reviewer at 562-593; a refused criterion does not create a manual-verification obligation, and story_1476_acceptance_trust_tests.rs:192-207 codifies that behavior. Do not rewrite verdict files, modify code, or merge. Return an independent disposition; existing verdict remains binding until normal rework/review process records a new head.
